question: The area of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box is 120 cm² , 72 cm² and 60 cm² , respectively. Find the volume (in cm³ ) of the box.
solution:
**Given:**

Areas of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box:

 
• Area 1 = 120 cm²
 
• Area 2 = 72 cm²
 
• Area 3 = 60 cm²

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = √(Area 1 × Area 2 × Area 3)

Let the dimensions of the cuboid be l, b, and h. We have:

 
• l × b = 120
 
• b × h = 72
 
• h × l = 60

Volume of the cuboid (V) = l × b × h = √(l × b × b × h × h × l)

**Calculation:**

⇒ V = √518400

⇒ V = 720 cm³

**∴ The volume of the cuboid is 720 cm³.**
